title: Scalable Structural Index Construction for JSON Analytics (Pison)
relevance: Introduced intra-record parallelism for structural index construction with depth-aware processing. Demonstrates that parallel depth tracking is practical and yields significant speedups.

title: GpJSON: High-performance JSON Data Processing on GPUs
relevance: Implements parallel structural indexing on GPUs using massively parallel depth tracking via GPU prefix-sum. Achieves 2.9x speedup showing parallel depth tracking at GPU scale.

title: cuJSON: A Highly Parallel JSON Parser for GPUs
relevance: Nesting structure recognition is one of cuJSON's three GPU phases. Breaks key dependencies in parsing to enable parallel depth computation for single large JSON files.
